events.name: Resource Policy Evaluator
events.text: Users in this role can evaluate resource policies to understand their impact and outcome. This role does not grant any read or write access to the policy definitions or assignments themselves, making it ideal for developers, testers, and automated tools that need to perform policy validation as part of a development or CI/CD pipeline.

events.name: Resource Policy Reader
events.text: Users in this role have read-only access to resource policy definitions, assignments, and the tenant-wide resource policy configuration in Microsoft Graph. They can also evaluate policies to understand their impact, making this role ideal for audit, compliance, and support personnel who need to validate and troubleshoot policies without the ability to modify them.

events.name: AutomationRules.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read all security automation rules and runs, without a signed-in user.

events.name: AutomationRules.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and write all security automation rules, and read their runs, without a signed-in user.

events.name: CloudLicensing.ClaimLicenses.All
events.text: Allows an approved app to claim and unclaim supported product licenses for users in the tenant, without a signed-in user.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement-Assignment.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read which users and security groups each Copilot spending policy applies to, without a signed-in user. This exposes the identifiers of the security groups and the users that are targeted by each policy.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement-Assignment.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and change which users and security groups each Copilot spending policy applies to, without a signed-in user. Adding or removing an assignment immediately changes which users are subject to that policy's spending limits, and may grant or remove their ability to consume Copilot credits. This also exposes the identifiers of the security groups targeted by each policy.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read Copilot spending policies and their configuration without a signed-in user, including budget limits and alert thresholds. This also exposes the identities of the users who created and last modified each policy and of the users who receive its alert notifications.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read, create, update, and delete Copilot spending policies without a signed-in user. It can set the initial audience, read and change alert recipients, and select a billing method. New or changed policies may take effect immediately and restrict user spending. The app can also see who created and last modified each policy.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement-Reports.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read the organization's aggregate Copilot cost data without a signed-in user, including its credit balance and usage and spending reports. It can also check Copilot cost export job status and download completed exports, which may contain full report details. This permission is separate from Reports.Read.All for Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reporting.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read all organizational Copilot cost management data without a signed-in user, including any user's credit balance, per-user rankings and itemized usage, usage by security group, spending policies, their configuration and assignments, and the identities of policy creators, modifiers, and alert recipients. This is the broadest Copilot cost management read permission.

events.name: InfoProtectAttributeAssignment.Read

events.name: MCP.Server.Access
